# SwiftShader

The runtime uses the OpenGL ES libraries from AOSP SwiftShader commit `9f7bb6637f6b8ffd8f0ae542f9e7481875a8281b`. Subzero and its LLVM subset are in the same source tree. The build includes `emutls.c`, `clear_cache.c`, and `int_util.c` from compiler-rt commit `aa9a1d65f4e4a4061b666effbc8b7225c1eab7d4`, with their MIT and University of Illinois/NCSA license text and credits bundled here. Local build scripts and compatibility headers are in `android7-prototype/swiftshader`. The AOSP build supplies the separate Android software GLES library. [SwiftShader source](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/swiftshader/+/9f7bb6637f6b8ffd8f0ae542f9e7481875a8281b/) · [compiler-rt builtins](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/compiler-rt/+/aa9a1d65f4e4a4061b666effbc8b7225c1eab7d4/lib/builtins/)
